scope: Symbolic notation, intermediate musical plans, musical grammar, phonetics, syllables, singing alignment, and fine-grained text-audio relations

records.title: NotaGen: Advancing Musicality in Symbolic Music Generation with Large Language Model Training Paradigms
records.claim: A language-model training pipeline can generate symbolic sheet music from ABC notation with metadata prompts.

records.title: Text2Score: Generating Sheet Music From Textual Prompts
records.claim: A structured intermediate plan can translate natural-language intent into generated notation.

records.title: MusicLayout: Explicit Structural Planning for Controllable Text-to-Music Generation
records.claim: An inspectable time-aligned layout can serve as an intermediate representation before audio generation.

records.title: Natural Language Processing Methods for Symbolic Music Generation and Information Retrieval: A Survey
records.claim: Music grammar research models relations such as tension/relaxation and harmony, while acknowledging the absence of a universally accepted grammar.

records.title: Transinger: Cross-Lingual Singing Voice Synthesis via IPA-Based Phonetic Alignment
records.claim: IPA offers a shared phonetic representation for cross-lingual singing synthesis.
limits: Does not imply Suno parses IPA prompts

records.title: Prompt-Singer: Controllable Singing-Voice-Synthesis with Natural Language
records.claim: A singing synthesis pipeline can separate lyric content, phoneme timing, pitch, and style prompting.

records.title: Singing to Speech Conversion with Generative Flow
records.claim: Transcription to ordinary text can discard phonetic and timing information present in singing.

records.title: STARS: A Unified Framework for Singing Transcription, Alignment, and Refined Style Annotation
records.claim: Singing can be annotated at nested phonetic, note, technique, and global-style levels.

records.title: FIGMA: Towards FIne-Grained Music retrievAl
records.claim: Fine-grained text-audio alignment can improve retrieval of musical attributes such as tempo, key, chords, and rhythm.

records.title: Don't CLAP: Are Music-Text Models Bag-of-Words?
records.claim: Tested contrastive music-text models often fail to distinguish captions that differ in attribute bindings or order.

records.title: CLaMP 3: Universal Music Information Retrieval Across Unaligned Modalities and Unseen Languages
records.claim: A shared retrieval framework can align music modalities and multilingual text, including unseen languages.

evidence_policy: Keep peer-reviewed work, preprints, surveys, community claims, and Suno-specific observations separate. Do not infer Suno's parsing or architecture from other systems.
